name: Pig Pen
description:
A pen where the bot keeps the best pigs for breeding and slaughters the rest.

Bots:
• Pig Manager
• Butcher (for the carcasses)

In each area:
• Pig pen: a fence with a gate; the animals live here and the area must cover them
• Animal carcasses: nothing: keep the ground free, carcasses are laid down here

Also needed:
• A herd setting chosen in the bot's options, which decides which animals are kept.
